verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a remote-desktop service, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows Parsec's core service (accounts, coordination, Teams management) can be self-hosted. The adjacent items don't count: peer-to-peer streaming, 'hosting' meaning running the streaming host on your own Windows/macOS machine, and an Enterprise relay point placed in your firewall. A community report also notes there is no public source code.
